description: This file defines a 'BiometricService' class which provides methods to check for biometric authentication capability and to perform biometric authentication, wrapping around the 'local_auth' package for cross-platform biometrics support.

classes.name: BiometricService
classes.description: A wrapper class around the 'local_auth' package to facilitate biometric authentication with platform-specific considerations.

methods.name: canAuthenticate
methods.description: Checks whether biometric authentication is available and supported on the device.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs biometric authentication with a provided reason string; returns true if authentication is successful, false otherwise.
